source_metadata.title: Accuracy and reproducibility of ChatGPT responses to real-world drug information questions
source_metadata.journal: JACCP: Journal of the American College of Clinical Pharmacy

extraction_limitations: The source evaluated ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 during March 2024; the atoms describe those tested versions and conditions, not later model generations.
The 30-question set was constructed from real-world questions encountered by the authors rather than sampled from a formally enumerated external question bank.
Accuracy depended on comparison with Lexicomp and pharmacist Likert ratings. The extraction does not re-adjudicate the clinical correctness of each underlying drug-information answer.
The supporting information was incorporated for the question inventory, detailed error example, reproducibility example, and usability survey. Bibliography entries were not atomized.
Atoms remain needs_review pending human source verification.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom QuantitativeResult has no first-class unit for its top-level estimate, so percentage and word-count units are carried in effect_measure text and arm observations.
The schema does not have dedicated AI-benchmark, prompt-protocol, or model-version fields; these are represented through method atoms, exposure details, tags, and provenance.
